slug: 2024-09-19 Algeria Digital Economy (US Country Commercial Guide)

facts.fact: The US International Trade Administration's country commercial guide states that data localisation is mandatory in Algeria, with data to be stored in-country, under Law No. 18-07, which came into force on 10 August 2023.

note: No use fact: the body text says the ANPDCP enforces Law 18-07 but does not tie it to the localisation rule (only the frontmatter hero line does).

systems.system: Centre national algérien des services numériques
systems.platform: Huawei-led consortium build, two active-active data centres at Mohammadia

note: Describes a national data centre built to host data on national territory; no rule requiring data to be kept in the country is stated.

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the Regulatory Authority of Post and Electronic Communications issued a rule in November 2017 requiring public cloud computing operators to build infrastructure in Algeria and host and store data locally.
The same cloud localisation rule was issued by the Regulatory Authority of Post and Electronic Communications, which licenses cloud data hosting providers, per Digital Policy Alert.
Digital Policy Alert says the Law on Audiovisual Activity entered into force in December 2024, requiring online audiovisual services to be hosted on servers physically located in Algeria.
